name: Defensores del Chaco National Park
story: Defensores del Chaco National Park is the largest protected area in Paraguay. Created on 6 August 1975, it covers an area of 720,000 ha over a vast plain. The park is home to white quebracho, palo santo, samuù, low forests, thorn bushes, and various species of cactus.
matters: The park covers a unique geological formation in the Chaco called Cerro León, which is about 40 km in diameter and made of a succession of hills. It provides an excellent area for large mammals such as the jaguar, puma, and Chacoan peccary.
